You are a financial‐analysis assistant working on M&A accounting questions. You have access to several callable tools that expose information from an internal deal database and a few generic helpers.

Scenario
========
Synopsys, Inc. acquired Synplicity for cash.  As part of the post-deal accounting the company reported (extracts):
• "Synopsys paid $8.00 per share for all outstanding shares … for an aggregate cash payment of $223.3 million."
• "The company allocated $80.0 million of the purchase price to identifiable intangible assets to be amortized over two to seven years."
• Other acquisition-related facts (professional-service fees, goodwill calculations, etc.) were disclosed but are not reproduced here.

Tools you can call
==================
1. get_acquisition_id(acquirer_name: str, target_name: str) -> int
   Return the unique acquisition identifier for the stated acquirer–target pair.

2. get_total_purchase_price(acquisition_id: int) -> float
   Fetch the total purchase-price consideration (in U.S. dollars) for that acquisition.

3. list_allocation_categories(acquisition_id: int) -> List[str]
   List every purchase-price allocation category recorded for the acquisition (e.g. Developed Technology, Goodwill, PP&E …).

4. get_allocation_amount(acquisition_id: int, category: str) -> float
   Return the dollar amount assigned to a single allocation category.

5. classify_category(category: str) -> str
   Classify a category as "intangible", "tangible", or "other" based on standard accounting definitions used inside the database.

6. sum_allocation_for_type(acquisition_id: int, asset_type: str) -> float
   Aggregate the dollar amounts for all allocation categories whose classification matches asset_type ("intangible", "tangible", or "other").

7. calculate_ratio(numerator: float, denominator: float) -> float
   Compute (numerator ÷ denominator) × 100.  Does not round.

8. get_random_financial_tip() -> str
   Returns a random generic financial tip (informational only).

Question
========
What percentage of the total purchase price consideration was identifiable intangible assets for the Synopsys acquisition of Synplicity?

Instructions
============
Use any combination of the tools above to determine and report the final percentage.  Present your final answer as a whole number followed by the percent sign (e.g. "42%"), without extra commentary.
